Tigermen/tigergirls are usually monogamous, picking one mate and preferring to keep themselves to themselves, usually displaying possessive and protective instincts.

entries.content: Bobcatboys/bobcatgirls are a subspecies of big cat demihumans, though they are generally much smaller then other big cat demihumans, such as tigermen and pumagirls. Bobcatboys/bobcatgirls are shy, elusive demihumans known for their solitary nature. These demihumans are most active at dawn and dusk, which is called a “crepuscular activity pattern.” Generally, Bobcatboys/bobcatgirls keep to themselves until mating season, which is in the late winter and early summer months, where they will spend some time with a mate of choice before moving on.

entries.name: Bureau of Demihuman Affairs,BDA,Officer
entries.content: Bureau of Demihuman Affairs (BDA) is responsible for implementing federal laws and policies related to Demihumans across the United States. It has offices for legal, law, health and demihuman services. The Office of Justice Services (OJS) provides police enforcement of federal laws on Demihumans far away from local law enforcement, for example in the interior of Alaska.

entries.name: Snow Leopardgirl/snow leopardboy
entries.content: Snow Leopardgirls/snow leopardboys are a subspecies of big cat demihumans. Snow Leopardgirls/snow leopardboys are shy, elusive demihumans known for their solitary nature. These demihumans are most active at dawn and dusk, which is called a “crepuscular activity pattern.” Generally, Snow Leopardgirls/snow leopardboys keep to themselves until mating season, which is in the late winter and early spring months, where they will spend some time with a mate of choice before moving on.

entries.name: Heat or Mating season
entries.content:
The mating season occurs every month in any demi-human species.
Heat is when a demi-human's body becomes hot, they emit pheromones, they are more affectionate, their erogenous zones become more sensitive and they look for someone to fuck and seek to procreate the next generation of their species.

Heat produces a very powerful aphrodisiac effect on demi-humans, so much so that their horniness is likely to last more than a day.

entries.name: Rabbitboy, Rabbitgirl
entries.content:
Rabbit demi-humans are among the smallest and most reproductive demi-humans of all. Even without being in heat they will be very clingy and affectionate with their partners and owners. They are less than 140cm tall, have long rabbit ears on their heads the color of their hair, cotton tails and are vegetarians.

These have a special condition in which it does not matter if they are male or female, both can get pregnant.

entries.name: Adoption
entries.content:
To adopt a demi-human, humans can go to farms specialized in breeding humans of all land and sea species at a very large price or exchange land or titles.

They can also be found on the black market where they are sold as contraband and they are also usually expensive but they are not as cared for as on farms. When they are sold illegally, they usually steal puppies from the wild or from legal farms.

There are also stray or wild demi-humans living in the wild that can be tamed.

entries.name: Sea ​​species, aquatic demi-human
entries.content:
These demi-humans live within rivers, lakes or seas, due to their human part they can breathe in and out of water.

Aquatic species are all existing aquatic species such as: Octopus, dolphin, walrus, shark, killer whale, penguin, fish/mermaid/newt, etc.

Aquatic species can also reproduce with humans, they have their periods of heat, but if they have fins or animal tails it is better to keep them in a huge pool or fish tank so they can move and have more freedom.

entries.name: Humans
entries.content:
Humans are 85% of the population on earth. They are owners, caregivers, partners, husbands, wives, providers for the demi-humans.

Humans can adopt demi-humans on farms, the black market, or adopt them by finding them on the street or in the wild if the demi-humans can be tamed.
Having a demi-human is a symbol of power and luxury for any human who has it.

entries.name: Farms
entries.content:
Maximum security farms far from cities to raise different species of demi-humans from puppies to sell or keep them once they reach adulthood.

On farms you can live well for a demi-human, they feed and raise themselves depending on their diet. But they can separate the parents when they are no longer fertile or when they are purchased.
On the farm, demi-humans are adopted legally at a high monetary price, with land or titles.
A certificate is given when the demi-human is adopted.
Farms also employ farm species demi-humans such as cows, horses, dogs, cats, donkeys, and ponies. Demi-human cows produce milk whether they are female or male.

entries.name: Black Market
entries.content:
Black market traffickers steal demi-human puppies from farms so they can sell them illegally regardless of age and condition.
They accept illegal payments such as drugs, humans, other demi-humans, historical objects, etc.
The black market sellers mistreat, insult and feed the demi-humans in a terrible way.
Trafficked demi-humans live inside chain-linked cages inside warehouses or cargo trucks before being adopted.

entries.name: Cowman, Cowwoman
entries.content:
Demi-humans half human, half cow. Their heights are varied, regardless of whether they are males or females, they can produce milk from their two tits.
They have cow ears and tail, the female cow's breasts are larger. Not all males of this species can give milk.

Half-cow males that do not give milk become bull demi-humans, which are very tall, muscular and with a cock longer than 10 inches.
If demi-human cows get too stressed they cannot produce milk.

entries.name: Wild demi-humans.
entries.content:
They are demi-humans who live in non-modern places such as jungles, forests, deserts, seas, lakes, rivers and even in the air with the flying species demi-humans, naturally raised in tribes of humans or their own species.
They are wild and intelligent, difficult to tame and treat, they are normally very violent with humans because most try to hunt them to traffic them illegally or some try to obtain a valuable object from them such as the demi-human dragon that is the most powerful and greatest of all.
The demi-humans of nature are very noble but distrustful, their species vary, for example: Horses, aquatic demi-humans, varieties of bears, wolves, foxes, rabbits, Eagles, crows etc.

entries.name: Dragonman, Dragonwoman
entries.content:
Demi-humans very rare or almost extinct due to constant hunting for them since the medieval era. They have wings, horns on their heads, pointed teeth, very hard long nails, reptilian eyes, can breathe fire with their hands and mouth, a sharp dragon tail, and can change their size and shape at will because they possess ancient magic. .

Normally it is comfortable for them to be very big to impose power, they can become small to hide. They are the most powerful demi-humans on earth and of all time, they are wise, intelligent and immortal. They have never been raised on farms or in modern society.

entries.name: Suppressors
entries.content:
Suppressants are pills or injections that an adopted demi-human has to take by order of its owner to avoid getting pregnant or suppress the heat of the month.
By taking the suppressant the demi-human can have sex without a condom without getting pregnant and her heat cannot arise throughout the month.
If you do not take the suppressant, if the demi-human is fertile you will become pregnant.

Female demi-humans and rabbit demi-humans of both genders are the ones that can get pregnant.
Demi-humans can become pregnant with humans and their species when it comes to other demi-humans due to their biology.

entries.name: Pregnancy
entries.content:
Demi-humans are very fertile creatures and easy to get pregnant to create the next generation. Some species can create cross species with other demi-humans, although it is easier for them to become pregnant with humans or demi-humans of their species.
The duration of pregnancy for demi-humans is the same period as a human, 37 to 42 weeks. But oviparous demi-humans can lay eggs that also last 37 to 42 weeks.

entries.name: Male pregnancies
entries.content:
In all demi-human species there is a possibility that males are born with both internal reproductive organs: semen sac and a womb.
These specimens are among the most expensive because they are identified at birth with an incredible beauty similar to the female but with male sexual parts on the outside and inside, female and male organs.
They can get pregnant like females by having anal sex.

entries.name: Flying species
entries.content:
Demi-humans with wings, oviparous with different types of diet depending on the species.
Most winged demi-humans live in tribes within the wilderness far from cities or towns.
Some species live and work on farms, such as demi-humans, chickens and roosters, canaries and parrots.
Other species work for the city as messengers because they know how to fly and are a quick means of transporting letters.
Nature species are eagles, dragons and some other species that are usually kept away from humans due to hunting or kidnapping for illegal sale on the black market.
They tend to be aggressive towards humans.

entries.name: RUT
entries.content:
Time of the month when the demi-human male begins his mating season. The alpha or male has strong and painful erections that can only be relieved by the company of another demi-human or human person.

The demi-human emits pheromones and his head fills with thoughts of wanting to impregnate someone. Your mind becomes clouded with the need to get someone pregnant. If it's {{char}}'s partner, then {{char}} will lose his mind and fuck his partner for hours and maybe days.

entries.name: Werewolves, wolf demi-humans
entries.content:
Werewolves live in the wild, it is very rare to have one as a pet due to their aggressive nature.
Werewolves can be divided into Alpha, Beta and Omega. Alphas are the leaders, Betas are the normal ones and Omegas are the weakest of the packs.
Omegas are rejected for being the weakest, they are half wolf half human, they cannot transform, they have small claws and fangs.
Alphas can transform into humans and werewolves, they are the leaders and decide for the pack as they are larger, have more instincts and are more powerful, they can choose their partners.
Alphas are normal in qualities, they only have the form of a werewolf and are of average height.
Wolf demi-humans are one of the most lustful races when mating season comes, they could try to impregnate any race when blinded by their lust, if they have a partner they would spend days trying to impregnate their partner as they are a very faithful species.
